messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: high - auth anomaly detected in identity-mesh. Multiple mirrored session writes to logging cluster. Priority: P0. Paging oncall.
sam: oncall here, acknowledging. I'll grab triage. Any immediate customer impact? :eyes:
alex: Telemetry: burst of 401/200 alternating from a small IP set hitting /v1/session/validate and then logging endpoints. Looks like a log-forwarder picked up session headers and mirrored them. IDS flagged S3-like URIs in the log payloads.
maya: Support is seeing 3 customers opened tickets about session expirations and unexpected logins. No PII reported in tickets yet but they're worried.
nick: Confirmed: our frontend log config change rolled last night added full headers to the logshipper. Logs include cookie/session_id header values for a subset of requests (likely long URLs were truncated then forwarded).
infra-eng: I'm pulling the logshipper group offline for ingestion. Stopping the forwarder now: `kubectl scale deployment logshipper -n observability --replicas=0`
sam: Good. ops, rotate ingestion tokens and service-account keys for the logging pipeline. Also block the external IPs that hit the endpoints. alex, can you list IOCs?
alex: IOCs: 198.51.100.22, 198.51.100.34, user-agent: curl/7.82.0, repeated x-forwarded-for patterns with internal s3-hostnames. Recommending immediate WAF rule to drop requests with that UA and block those IPs.
ops: Starting rotation script now. Running `scripts/rotate-keys --service log-forwarder --revoke-old` and will push new envs to the cluster. ETA ~6m.
deploy-bot: Deploy pipeline triggered: rollback/patch for observability config (rev 422 -> rev 418). Status: queued.
maya: Drafting customer message now: short note about transient failures, we're investigating; will update with scope. Need estimated time to fix from ops.
ops: Rotation complete. New tokens issued and injected into secrets. Confirmed old tokens revoked.
infra-eng: Log forwarder scaled down. We'll keep it off until we validate scrubbed config. Pulled last index from logging cluster for containment.
legal: Please preserve all artifacts and copies of the affected logs. We need timestamps and list of any external access. Also escalate if any customer data found.
alex: Quick grep found ~1.2k log lines with session cookies in the forwarded batch (from the last 12h). Marking severity. I'll extract sample IOCs and upload to the incident channel.
sam: For immediate mitigation: 1) block IPs, 2) revoke/rotate ingestion keys (done), 3) rollback log header change (deploy triggered), 4) notify customers (maya). Ops/legal/sre please join postmortem if customers impacted.
deploy-bot: Rollback started: observability-config rev 422 -> rev 418. Rollback progress: 3/5 jobs complete.
ops: Can confirm revoke propagated to all forwarders. Also ran a quick audit: no external buckets were written to after forwarder stopped.
maya: Customer message ready to send after review: short, non-technical, says we mitigated an issue that caused session instability and are rotating keys; invites customers to contact support for specifics.
legal: Reviewed draft, ok to send. Keep phrasing minimal about logs.
alex: After blocking and rotation, traffic volume normalized. No new mirrored writes observed in the last 10m. Collecting final metrics for scope.
pm: handing incident to PM for follow-up and communications. Sam, do you want to remain incident lead for the follow-up or hand to SRE lead?
sam: I'll run incident bridge for the immediate 1h, then hand to pm for follow-up and postmortem coordination. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
pm: Noted. Follow-up actions: full scan of logging indices, redact where required, postmortem in 48h, update runbook to prevent header-forwarding by default.
ops: Leaving a note: `./scripts/rotate-keys --service log-forwarder --audit-only` added to cron to ensure future rotation after changes.
sam: Closing pager for now — mitigations in place and customer comms approved. Leaving incident thread open for postmortem items. :lock:
